paper.citation: Yiu, S., Fong, E., Holmes, C. and Rousseau, J. (2025). Semiparametric posterior corrections. Journal of the Royal Statistical Society: Series B 87(4), 1025-1054. DOI: 10.1093/jrsssb/qkaf005.
paper.venue: Journal of the Royal Statistical Society: Series B
paper.source_locator: Section 6.2, journal p. 1045 / local main-text PDF p. 21; Table 2 journal p. 1046 / PDF p. 22 labels outcome-mean estimation.

mechanism.name: Piecewise response mean with discontinuous MAR propensity

generation_equations.label: Observed encoding
generation_equations.expression: Y_observed=Y if R=1, else finite zero placeholder.

observed_variables.name: Y_observed
observed_variables.role: outcome if R=1; zero placeholder otherwise; mask using R

assumptions: R is conditionally independent of Y given fully observed covariates (MAR).

properties.notes: Piecewise conditional mean, heteroskedastic outcome, and 0.1/0.9 MAR observation probability.

estimand.name: theta = E(Y)
estimand.definition: Full-data superpopulation response mean before outcome masking.

truth.expression: Full-data superpopulation response mean before outcome masking.
truth.derivation: Integrate the four source-specified polynomial branches under Uniform[-1,1]: E(Y)=27/32.

adaptations: One generator call returns one iid sample rather than reproducing paper Monte Carlo estimator comparisons.
Unobserved Y is encoded by a finite zero placeholder and must always be masked by R.
Source explicitly attributes this DGP to Kennedy (2023), with piecewise regression originally from Györfi et al. (2002); check mechanism-level duplication.
The exact numerical E(Y) is derived by integration from the paper-specified DGP; the paper does not state the evaluated number.
warnings: No explicit latent-variable metadata or reliably identifiable latent declarations; absence from this list does not prove that no latent variables exist.
